title: One Sample Suffices for Matroid Prophet Inequalities against an Almighty Adversary

abstractEnglish: We prove that one independent sample per element suffices for a constant-competitive prophet inequality on every finite matroid. The guarantee holds even when the arrival-order adversary observes all samples, all online values, and the algorithm's entire random seed. The rule needs no description of the value distributions and achieves the absolute competitive ratio $`2^{-310}`$.
